crossRefs.note: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, “Father, I…
I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe…
We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one…
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

translations.web: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
translations.bsb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
translations.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
translations.asv: And even now I know that, whatsoever thou shalt ask of God, God will give thee.
